name: mnemos
description: Your memory and skills for Claude, stored on this computer, split into spaces.
long_description: Runs Mnemos in local mode: notes in SQLite under your Mnemos folder, no Docker, no account. By default one install serves every space (personal, work…): Claude saves to its default space and asks before using another. Set Space to one name to limit it to that space. Claude is told to treat it as its own long-term memory: it searches Mnemos at the start of each conversation and saves durable facts you share (preferences, decisions, people, projects) without being asked.

home.title: Mnemos folder
home.description: Where your notes and skills live (created if empty).

context.title: Space
context.description: "all" (default): every space. Or one space name (e.g. personal) to limit Claude to it.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search your memory. Claude calls it at the start of each conversation with the topic at hand.

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Remember a durable fact you shared (preference, decision, person, project). Never secrets.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List saved notes (to find one to fix).

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Correct a note that changed instead of duplicating it.

tools.name: skills_get
tools.description: Read a skill and follow it.
